reason: As a frugal practitioner running a two-person office, paying ₹12,990 upfront makes no sense when Docketra offers a ₹0 Free Pilot for two seats that lets me test the Trainee Laptop Shield and WhatsApp bridge first.
objection: My clients will never use an intake portal—they just dump bills on WhatsApp, and I must be certain the Trainee Laptop Shield actually stops clerks from taking client data home on personal laptops before I spend any money.
would_change_my_mind: Verifying on the free pilot that the Trainee Laptop Shield completely blocks file downloads to personal laptops and that WhatsApp forwarding requires zero extra manual overhead.
